answers.reason: The faculty administrative officer holds no office granting access to the senate.
The budget planning round involves higher office holders due to university-wide planning.
Appointment committees are restricted to higher ranks and specific roles.
Faculty council participation requires specific office or regulation provision not held by the administrative officer.
The faculty administrative officer is not designated a seat in the study commission.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations but is not a member of the examination board by default.
Internal research funding rounds are outside the administrative officer's remit.
Module revision is an academic working group rather than an administrative duty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by academic or specialized staff.
Orientation week planning does not automatically include the faculty administrative officer.
